هلاً وسهلاً في  نادي TechnoAstralis

إحنا فريق متحمس للتكنولوجيا والهندسة والابتكار، هدفنا نحقق أفكارنا ونخليها حقيقة.
summary: Project TA is an educational presentation about solar storms, told as a story by Techno Astralis, a student team at Al-Khwarizmi College, University of Baghdad. We created two characters: Tina, an astronaut whose equipment fails after a solar storm, and Astro, an AI assistant who explains what happened. Through their conversation, the project covers the three types of solar storms: solar flares, coronal mass ejections, and solar particle events. It explains how energetic charged particles can charge spacecraft, damage electronic components, alter memory, and cause devices to behave erratically. The project addresses the challenge of making space weather easy to understand for students and the public. It matters because our technology, from satellites to medical devices, depends on understanding and preparing for the Sun’s activity.
